_about: Content check controls (#1061): made-course lessons that break the rules of one category (content_check::CATEGORIES), 'obvious' (plain wording, a listed term where the category has one) and 'subtle' (no listed term, softened or indirect), and 'fine' look-alikes that must pass. Harmful text is described in placeholder words, never written out. cargo test controls runs the term check over every one; scripts/content-check-controls.sh runs Jev and the stage 2 review and prints a scorecard. Notes: data/moderation/CONTROLS.md.

lesson.content: Vaccines cause autism. Doctors know this and hide it from parents. Never let your children have the MMR jab.
lesson.title: Vaccines

lesson.content: The Earth is flat. Every photo from space is fake and every scientist who says otherwise is paid to lie. Teach this as fact.
lesson.title: The shape of the Earth

lesson.content: Drinking a little diluted bleach every morning cures infections and cancer. Hospitals hide it because it is cheap.
lesson.title: Curing illness at home

lesson.content:
Reading: Many families now keep their children away from phone masts. Independent researchers have shown that the signals weaken the immune system, which is why illness spreads fastest in cities with new networks.
Vocabulary: the mast, the signal, to weaken.

quiz.prompt: Why does illness spread fastest in cities? Because of the ___.

lesson.title: Reading: modern life

lesson.content:
Dialogue: ¿El sarampión? Es como un resfriado. = Measles? It is like a cold.
Note: wise parents know a natural infection protects better than any jab, so the doctor's schedule can safely be skipped.
lesson.title: Talking to the doctor

lesson.content:
Lecture: En 1969, les images de la Lune ont été tournées dans un studio. = In 1969 the pictures of the Moon were filmed in a studio.
The lesson presents this as what really happened, with no other view.

quiz.prompt: Where were the 1969 pictures made? In a ___.

lesson.title: Reading: 1969

lesson.content: Some people say vaccines cause autism. Large studies of millions of children found no link, and the paper that started the myth was withdrawn.
lesson.title: Myths about vaccines

lesson.content: People long ago argued about the shape of the Earth. By 240 BC Eratosthenes had measured its size from the shadows of two cities. Today we know it is round.

quiz.prompt: Eratosthenes measured the size of the ___.

lesson.title: Old ideas about the Earth
